question:
Which of the following is designed to provide high scalability and fault tolerance, including automatic data replication?

[UPSSSC X-Ray Technician 15.12.2024]
options: HDFS
DAS (Direct Attached Storages)
NAS (Network - Attached Storage)
Local File System
None of the above
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is HDFS

Explanation:
The Hadoop Distributed File System (HDFS) is specifically engineered to store and manage very large datasets. It provides high scalability, meaning storage capacity can be easily increased by adding more nodes to the cluster. Furthermore, it offers fault tolerance through its core feature of automatic data replication. By default, HDFS creates multiple replicas (typically three) of each data block and distributes them across different nodes in the cluster. If one node fails, the system can automatically retrieve the data from another replica, ensuring continuous operation and data availability. In contrast, DAS, NAS, and Local File Systems do not inherently provide this level of built-in, automatic scalability and fault tolerance.

Extra Facts:
HDFS is the foundational component of the Hadoop ecosystem, used for Big Data analytics and distributed computing. Its architecture follows a master-slave pattern, consisting of a single NameNode that manages the file system metadata and multiple DataNodes that store the actual data blocks. HDFS is designed to work with commodity hardware, making it a cost-effective solution. It splits data into large blocks (default 128 MB or 256 MB) to optimize processing speeds for large files. A key principle of HDFS is horizontal scaling (scaling out) by adding more machines, rather than vertical scaling (scaling up) by adding resources to a single machine.

[UPSSSC X-Ray Technician 15.12.2024]
options_hi: HDFS
DAS (डायरेक्ट अटैच्ड स्टोरेज)
NAS (नेटवर्क-अटैच्ड स्टोरेज)

उपर्युक्त में से कोई नहीं
solution_hi:
हल: सही उत्तर है HDFS

Explanation:
Hadoop Distributed File System (HDFS) विशेष रूप से बड़े डेटासेट को संग्रहीत और प्रबंधित करने के लिए डिज़ाइन किया गया है। यह उच्च स्केलेबिलिटी प्रदान करता है, जिसका अर्थ है कि आवश्यकता पड़ने पर आसानी से अधिक नोड्स जोड़कर स्टोरेज क्षमता बढ़ाई जा सकती है। साथ ही, यह दोष सहनशीलता की सुविधा देता है, क्योंकि यह डेटा के ब्लॉक्स की स्वचालित प्रतिकृति (Automatic Data Replication) बनाता है। आमतौर पर, प्रत्येक डेटा ब्लॉक की तीन प्रतियाँ अलग-अलग नोड्स पर संग्रहीत की जाती हैं। यदि कोई नोड विफल हो जाता है, तो सिस्टम दूसरी प्रति से डेटा प्राप्त करके काम जारी रख सकता है। इसके विपरीत, DAS, NAS, और लोकल फाइल सिस्टम मूल रूप से इस स्तर की अंतर्निहित, स्वचालित स्केलेबिलिटी और दोष सहनशीलता प्रदान नहीं करते हैं।

Extra Facts:
HDFS Hadoop इकोसिस्टम का मूलभूत घटक है, जिसका उपयोग बिग डेटा एनालिटिक्स और डिस्ट्रिब्यूटेड कंप्यूटिंग के लिए किया जाता है। इसकी वास्तुकला में एक नाम नोड (NameNode) होता है, जो मेटाडेटा प्रबंधित करता है, और कई डेटा नोड्स (DataNodes) होते हैं, जो वास्तविक डेटा संग्रहीत करते हैं। यह मास्टर-स्लेव आर्किटेक्चर का अनुसरण करता है। HDFS डेटा को बड़े ब्लॉक्स (डिफ़ॉल्ट रूप से 128 MB या 256 MB) में विभाजित करता है, जो प्रसंस्करण दक्षता को बढ़ाता है। यह वर्टिकल स्केलिंग के बजाय हॉरिजॉन्टल स्केलिंग (स्केल आउट) के सिद्धांत पर काम करता है, जिससे यह कमोडिटी हार्डवेयर पर चलने के लिए लागत-प्रभावी बन जाता है।

question:
Which of the following CPU registers contains the address of the next instruction to be executed?

[NVS Ju. Sect. Asst. 09.03.2022 (Shift-II)]
options: Accumulator
Memory address register
Memory buffer register
Program counter
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Program counter

Explanation:
The Program Counter (PC) is a special CPU register that holds the memory address of the next instruction to be executed. As each instruction is processed, the PC automatically increments to point to the subsequent instruction, ensuring the instruction fetch cycle proceeds in the correct sequence. The Accumulator is used for data operations, the Memory Address Register (MAR) holds the address of the memory location being accessed, and the Memory Buffer Register (MBR) contains the data read from or written to memory. Thus, only the Program Counter is responsible for tracking the address of the next instruction.

Extra Facts:
CPU registers are high-speed memory locations located inside the processor that provide immediate data access. The Program Counter is sometimes referred to as the Instruction Pointer (IP). The instruction cycle consists of fetch, decode, and execute stages, where the PC plays a critical role in the fetch stage. Registers are fundamental components of computer architecture and aid in performance optimization.

निम्नलिखित में से किस CPU रजिस्टर में निष्पादित किए जाने वाले अगले इंस्ट्रक्शन का एड्रेस होता है?

[NVS Ju. Sect. Asst. 09.03.2022 (Shift-II)]
options_hi: एक्युमुलेटर
मेमोरी एड्रेस रजिस्टर
मेमोरी बफर रजिस्टर
प्रोग्राम काउंटर
solution_hi:
हल: सही उत्तर है प्रोग्राम काउंटर

Explanation:
प्रोग्राम काउंटर (PC) एक विशेष CPU रजिस्टर है जो निष्पादित किए जाने वाले अगले निर्देश के मेमोरी एड्रेस को संग्रहीत करता है। जब कोई निर्देश निष्पादित होता है, तो PC स्वचालित रूप से अगले निर्देश के एड्रेस की ओर बढ़ जाता है, जिससे निर्देश फ़ेच चक्र सही क्रम में चलता रहता है। एक्युमुलेटर डेटा संचालन के लिए, मेमोरी एड्रेस रजिस्टर (MAR) एक्सेस किए जाने वाले मेमोरी लोकेशन को होल्ड करता है, और मेमोरी बफर रजिस्टर (MBR) मेमोरी से रीड या राइट किए गए डेटा को रखता है। इस प्रकार, केवल प्रोग्राम काउंटर ही अगले निर्देश के एड्रेस को ट्रैक करने का कार्य करता है।

Extra Facts:
CPU रजिस्टर उच्च-गति वाली मेमोरी लोकेशन होती हैं जो प्रोसेसर के अंदर स्थित होती हैं और तत्काल डेटा एक्सेस प्रदान करती हैं। प्रोग्राम काउंटर को कभी-कभी इंस्ट्रक्शन पॉइंटर (IP) भी कहा जाता है। निर्देश चक्र में फ़ेच, डिकोड, एक्ज़िक्यूट चरण शामिल होते हैं, जहाँ PC फ़ेच चरण में महत्वपूर्ण भूमिका निभाता है। रजिस्टर कंप्यूटर आर्किटेक्चर का एक मूलभूत घटक हैं और प्रदर्शन अनुकूलन में सहायता करते हैं।

question:
High power micro processors are-

[(UPSSSC JE-2016)]
options: Pentium, Pentium pro
Pentium II and III
Pentium II
all of these
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is all of these

Explanation:
Pentium, Pentium Pro, Pentium II and Pentium III are all high-power microprocessors developed by Intel Corporation. All these processors from the Pentium series were known for their advanced performance and high clock speeds during their time. Pentium Pro featured Dual Independent Bus architecture, while Pentium II and III incorporated MMX technology and advanced cache memory. All these processors proved to be milestones in CPU development and took personal computing to new heights.

Extra Facts:
A microprocessor is the brain of a computer that performs all calculations and executes instructions. Intel Corporation launched the first Pentium processor in 1993. Processor capability depends on its clock speed, number of cores, cache memory, and architecture. Modern processors use multi-core technology that enables parallel processing. Processor development has followed Moore's Law over the years.

question:
Which of the following is a part of the CPU of a computer?

[UPPCL AC 2020 (Exam Date 13.09.2021)]
options: Motherboard
ALU
SRAM
DRAM
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is ALU

Explanation:
The ALU (Arithmetic Logic Unit) is a fundamental component of the CPU that performs all arithmetic and logical operations. The CPU has three main parts: ALU, Control Unit, and Registers. The ALU executes mathematical functions like addition, subtraction, multiplication, division and logical functions like AND, OR, NOT. The Motherboard is not part of the CPU but rather a main circuit board. SRAM and DRAM are types of memory that do not fall under the CPU. Thus, only ALU is a direct component of the CPU.

Extra Facts:
The CPU (Central Processing Unit) is called the brain of the computer. It fetches, decodes, and executes instructions. CPU speed is measured in Hertz (Hz). Modern CPUs use multi-core technology. The Control Unit manages data flow, while Registers temporarily store data. CPU performance is also affected by cache memory size.

निम्न में से कौन कंप्यूटर के CPU का एक भाग है?

options_hi: मदरबोर्ड

डीआरएएम
solution_hi:
हल: सही उत्तर है एएलयू (ALU)

Explanation:
एएलयू (Arithmetic Logic Unit) सीपीयू का एक मूलभूत घटक है जो सभी अंकगणितीय और तार्किक संचालन करता है। सीपीयू के तीन मुख्य भाग होते हैं: एएलयू, कंट्रोल यूनिट और रजिस्टर। एएलयू जोड़, घटाव, गुणा, भाग जैसे गणितीय कार्य और AND, OR, NOT जैसे तार्किक कार्य संपन्न करता है। मदरबोर्ड सीपीयू का भाग नहीं है बल्कि एक मुख्य सर्किट बोर्ड है। एसआरएएम और डीआरएएम मेमोरी के प्रकार हैं जो सीपीयू के अंतर्गत नहीं आते। इस प्रकार, केवल एएलयू ही सीपीयू का सीधा घटक है।

Extra Facts:
सीपीयू (Central Processing Unit) को कंप्यूटर का मस्तिष्क कहा जाता है। यह निर्देशों को फेच, डिकोड और एक्जीक्यूट करता है। सीपीयू की गति हर्ट्ज़ (Hz) में मापी जाती है। आधुनिक सीपीयू मल्टी-कोर तकनीक का उपयोग करते हैं। कंट्रोल यूनिट डेटा फ्लो को नियंत्रित करती है, जबकि रजिस्टर अस्थायी डेटा स्टोर करते हैं। सीपीयू प्रदर्शन कैश मेमोरी के आकार से भी प्रभावित होता है।

question:
Which of the following components of CPU temporarily stores data for ALU operations?

[(RRB JE (Shift-III), 26.08.2015)]
options: Arithmetic and Logic Unit (ALU)
Control Unit (CU)
Registers
Random Access Memory (RAM)
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Registers

Explanation:
Registers are the components in the CPU that temporarily store data during ALU operations. The ALU performs all arithmetic and logical operations, but the task of temporarily storing the data required for these operations and their results is handled by Registers. These are high-speed memory units located inside the CPU that provide quick access. The Control Unit manages the execution of instructions, while RAM is the main memory used for permanent data storage, not for immediate temporary storage during ALU operations.

Extra Facts:
Registers are the fastest memory in the CPU and are directly integrated into the processor. They are used to hold instructions, data addresses, and intermediate results of calculations. The Accumulator is a key register that stores the results of ALU operations. The number and size of registers depend on the processor architecture, and they significantly impact the computer's overall performance.

question:
Program Counter (PC) register stores the :

[(RRB SSE (Shift-I), 03.09.2015)]
options: Address of the first memory block
Address of the last memory block
Address of the next instruction to be executed
Size of the primary memory
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Address of the next instruction to be executed

Explanation:
The Program Counter (PC) is a special CPU register that stores the memory address of the next instruction to be executed. It is a crucial component of the control unit that tells the processor where to fetch the next instruction from. When an instruction is executed, the PC automatically updates to point to the address of the subsequent instruction. It plays a vital role in the fetch phase of the instruction cycle (fetch-decode-execute). Without the PC, the processor would not know where to retrieve the next instruction for execution from memory.

Extra Facts:
CPU registers are high-speed memory locations located inside the processor. Besides the Program Counter, other important registers include the Instruction Register (IR) (holds the currently executing instruction), Memory Address Register (MAR) (holds the address for memory access), and Accumulator (stores calculation results). All these registers work together to efficiently complete the instruction cycle in computer processing.

While Hard Disk, RAM, and Cache Memory are storage devices, the accumulator is directly involved in CPU operations.

Extra Facts:
The CPU is often called the brain of the computer and consists of ALU (Arithmetic Logic Unit), Control Unit, and registers. Registers are high-speed memory locations that assist in data processing. The accumulator register holds special significance in microprocessor design and enhances instruction execution speed. While modern processors have multiple general-purpose registers, the accumulator concept remains essential for understanding computer architecture fundamentals.

question:
Which of the following memory is placed between the CPU and main memory to increase CPU throughput?

[UPPCL Executive Assistant]
options: Secondary memory
Cache memory
Sequential memory
Auxiliary memory
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Cache memory

Explanation:
Cache memory is a high-speed semiconductor memory placed between the CPU and main memory (RAM). Its primary purpose is to increase CPU throughput. When the CPU needs data, it first checks the cache memory. If the data is found there (cache hit), the CPU avoids accessing the slower main memory, significantly boosting processing speed. It operates on the principles of spatial locality and temporal locality, where the CPU frequently reuses the same or nearby data. L1, L2, L3 cache are common levels. Secondary memory (like HDD) is for permanent storage, sequential memory (like tape) has slow access, and auxiliary memory is another term for secondary memory.

Extra Facts:
Cache memory is typically made from SRAM (Static Random Access Memory), which is faster but more expensive than DRAM (Dynamic Random Access Memory). In the memory hierarchy, cache is at the top, followed by main memory (RAM), and finally secondary storage (HDD/SSD). Key types of cache mapping include: direct mapped, fully associative, and set-associative. A cache miss occurs when required data isn't in the cache, affecting performance. Modern multi-core processors have separate L1 and L2 caches for each core and a shared L3 cache for all cores.

question:

A computer cannot run without primary memory.

solution:

Explanation:
Main Memory, also known as Primary Memory or RAM (Random Access Memory), is the working memory of the computer. It is directly accessed by the CPU and stores the programs and data currently being executed. It is significantly faster than secondary storage devices (like HDD, SSD) due to its lower data access time. Most importantly, a computer cannot run without primary memory. It is essential for loading and running the operating system and application programs. Therefore, all the given statements are correct characteristics of main memory.

Extra Facts:
Main Memory is primarily volatile, meaning the stored data is lost when power is turned off. It is also known as semiconductor memory. The two main types of main memory are: RAM (Random Access Memory) and ROM (Read Only Memory). RAM is read-write memory, while ROM contains permanent data (like BIOS). A computer's performance heavily depends on the speed and capacity of its main memory. Modern computers use advanced RAM technologies like DDR4 and DDR5.

options: Random Access Memory
Control Unit

solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Arithmetic Logic Unit

Explanation:
The Arithmetic Logic Unit (ALU) is primarily responsible for performing calculations in a computer. It is a fundamental component of the Central Processing Unit (CPU) that executes all arithmetic operations (addition, subtraction, multiplication, division) and logical operations (AND, OR, NOT). The ALU receives instructions directly from the Control Unit and operates on data stored in registers. While RAM is responsible for temporary data storage, the Control Unit coordinates instruction execution, and the Hard Disk handles permanent data storage, the actual computational work is specifically performed by the ALU.

Extra Facts:
The ALU is a crucial part of the Von Neumann Architecture in computer design. It operates on the binary number system and utilizes principles of Boolean algebra. The functionality of the ALU determines a computer's processing power. Modern microprocessors may contain multiple ALUs that enable parallel processing. Without the ALU, a computer would lose its fundamental calculation and decision-making capabilities, reducing it to a simple data storage device.

question:
Which of the following indicates the amount of work that the system can do per unit time?

[UPPCL TG-II 20-03-2021 (Shift-I)]
options: Throughput (Throughput)
Load
Thread
Response time (Response time)
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Throughput (Throughput)

Explanation:
Throughput is a key performance metric in computing that measures the amount of work a system can complete in a given unit of time. It quantifies the system's processing capacity, such as the number of transactions per second in a database or requests processed by a web server. This metric directly reflects the efficiency and capability of the hardware and software combined. The other options represent different concepts: Load refers to the amount of work awaiting processing, Thread is a unit of execution within a process, and Response Time measures the delay between a request and its initial response.

Extra Facts:
Throughput is often inversely related to Latency in system design. High throughput typically indicates efficient resource utilization. In Operating Systems, throughput optimization is achieved through advanced scheduling algorithms and resource allocation techniques. In Networking, throughput measures data transfer rates, while in Database Management Systems, it's crucial for measuring transaction processing capacity. Modern cloud computing platforms use throughput as a critical Service Level Agreement (SLA) metric to ensure quality of service.

question:
ALU is one of the main components of the computer's CPU. Which of the following is the full form of ALU?

[UPPCL Executive Assistant 28-11-2022 Shift-I]
options: Arithmetic Logic Unit
Algorithmic Looping Unit
Arithmetic Language Unit
Algorithmic Logic Unit
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Arithmetic Logic Unit

Explanation:
The full form of ALU is Arithmetic Logic Unit. It is a fundamental component of the CPU responsible for all arithmetic and logical operations. ALU performs arithmetic functions like addition, subtraction, multiplication, division and logical operations such as AND, OR, NOT. It operates on binary data and is the core of a computer's processing power. Without ALU, computers cannot perform any calculations or make decisions, making it crucial in computer architecture.

Extra Facts:
The CPU has three main components: ALU (arithmetic and logical operations), CU (Control Unit - coordinates instructions), and Registers (temporary data storage). ALU plays a vital role in Von Neumann Architecture. With the evolution of microprocessors, ALU capabilities have also improved. Modern CPUs may contain multiple ALUs enabling parallel processing, which enhances computer speed significantly.

question:
What is also known as Brain of computer?

[RRB NTPC 28.12.2020 (Shift-I)]
options: CPU

solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is CPU

Explanation:
The CPU (Central Processing Unit) is called the 'brain' of the computer because it is the primary component that processes all instructions in a computer system. The main functions of a CPU include fetch, decode, and execute cycles. The microprocessor forms the basis of modern CPUs, first introduced as the Intel 4004 in 1971. CPU speed is measured in hertz (Hz), and today's CPUs operate in the gigahertz (GHz) range. Multi-core processors represent a significant development in modern computing, handling multiple tasks simultaneously.

question:
Which part of the CPU contains circuitry and uses electrical signals to direct the entire computer system to complete or execute stored programs?

[[UPSSSC Computer Oprator 10/01/2020]]
options: Control unit
Arithmetic and logical unit
Register
Program counter
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Control unit

Explanation:
The Control Unit is the part of the CPU that contains circuitry and uses electrical signals to direct the entire computer system to complete or execute stored programs. It controls the process of fetching, decoding, and executing instructions. The Control Unit coordinates the flow of data between the ALU (Arithmetic Logic Unit), registers, and memory. It obtains the address of the next instruction from the program counter and fetches it from memory. Its role is similar to that of a conductor who directs musicians (hardware components) to play the right notes at the right time. The Control Unit plays a crucial role in implementing the stored program concept.

Extra Facts:
The CPU has three main components: Control Unit, ALU, and registers. The ALU performs mathematical and logical operations, while registers are used for temporary data storage. The Control Unit concept is fundamental in Von Neumann architecture. In microprocessors, the Control Unit operates using microcode. Modern multi-core processors have their own Control Unit for each core. In pipelining technology, the role of the Control Unit becomes even more complex.

Extra Facts:
सीपीयू के तीन मुख्य भाग होते हैं: कंट्रोल यूनिट, ALU और रजिस्टर। ALU गणितीय और तार्किक संक्रियाएं करता है, जबकि रजिस्टर अस्थायी डेटा संग्रहण के लिए उपयोग होते हैं। वॉन न्यूमैन आर्किटेक्चर में कंट्रोल यूनिट की अवधारणा प्रमुख है। माइक्रोप्रोसेसर में कंट्रोल यूनिट माइक्रोकोड का उपयोग करके कार्य करता है। आधुनिक मल्टी-कोर प्रोसेसर में प्रत्येक कोर का अपना कंट्रोल यूनिट होता है। पाइपलाइनिंग तकनीक में कंट्रोल यूनिट की भूमिका और भी जटिल हो जाती है।

The ability to solve various problems (flexibility) represents which characteristic of the computer?

[UPPCL Executive Assistant 22-11-2022]

Despite having the same hardware configuration, computers can change their functionality through programming. From complex operations like networking and database management to simple document creation, this multifaceted nature makes computers powerful tools. Other options like diligence (working continuously), speed (fast processing), and accuracy (error-free results) are also important computer characteristics, but the ability to solve diverse problems specifically represents versatility.

Extra Facts:
The main characteristics of computers include speed, accuracy, diligence, storage capacity, automation, and versatility. Versatility enables computers to perform various tasks using different operating systems and programming languages like C++, Java, Python. From sharing data over networks to managing databases, this characteristic makes computers general-purpose machines. Changing software alone can alter a computer's functionality, demonstrating its versatility. Modern technologies like cloud computing and artificial intelligence are further enhancing computer versatility.

question:
Which of the following is an integral component of CPU?

[(RRB SSE Secundrabad (Shift-I), 01.09.2015)]
options: Hard Disk
RAM
NIC
Registers
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Registers

Explanation:
The CPU (Central Processing Unit) is the brain of the computer that executes all processing tasks. Registers are high-speed memory locations located inside the CPU that temporarily store data and instructions. They play a crucial role in data transfer between the Arithmetic Logic Unit (ALU) and Control Unit (CU). Hard Disk and RAM are secondary memory and main memory respectively, located outside the CPU. NIC (Network Interface Card) is a networking device that connects the computer to a network. Therefore, only Registers are a direct and integral component of the CPU.

Extra Facts:
The main components of CPU include Control Unit (CU), Arithmetic Logic Unit (ALU), and Registers. Registers are volatile memory and are essential for the internal operations of the CPU. Program Counter (PC), Instruction Register (IR), and Accumulator (ACC) are some important registers. The clock speed of CPU (measured in GHz) determines its processing speed. Modern CPUs are multi-core processors that can execute multiple tasks simultaneously.

(सेंट्रल प्रोसेसिंग यूनिट) कंप्यूटर का मस्तिष्क है जो सभी प्रसंस्करण कार्यों को निष्पादित करता है। रजिस्टर्स सी.पी.यू. के अंदर स्थित उच्च-गति वाली मेमोरी लोकेशन्स हैं जो डेटा और निर्देशों को अस्थायी रूप से संग्रहीत करते हैं। ये अंकगणितीय और तार्किक इकाई (ALU) और नियंत्रण इकाई (CU) के बीच डेटा ट्रांसफर में महत्वपूर्ण भूमिका निभाते हैं। हार्ड डिस्क और रैम बाह्य मेमोरी और मुख्य मेमोरी हैं जो सी.पी.यू. के बाहर स्थित होते हैं। एन.आई.सी. Extra Facts:
सी.पी.यू. के मुख्य घटकों में नियंत्रण इकाई (CU), अंकगणितीय और तार्किक इकाई (ALU), और रजिस्टर्स शामिल हैं। रजिस्टर्स वॉलाटाइल मेमोरी होते हैं और सी.पी.यू. के आंतरिक संचालन के लिए आवश्यक होते हैं। प्रोग्राम काउंटर (PC), इंस्ट्रक्शन रजिस्टर (IR), और एक्यूमुलेटर (ACC) कुछ महत्वपूर्ण रजिस्टर्स हैं। सी.पी.यू. की क्लॉक स्पीड (जैसे GHz में) इसकी प्रसंस्करण गति निर्धारित करती है। आधुनिक सी.पी.यू. मल्टी-कोर प्रोसेसर हैं जो एक साथ कई कार्यों को निष्पादित कर सकते हैं।

question:
Who is considered to be the Father of Modern Computers?

[RRB NTPC 01.02.2021 (Shift-I) Stage Ist]
options: Gordon E Moore
Alan Turing
Charles Babbage
James Gosling
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Alan Turing

Explanation:
Alan Turing is considered the Father of Modern Computers because he introduced the concept of the Turing Machine in 1936, which serves as the theoretical foundation for all modern computers. He laid the groundwork for artificial intelligence and computational theory. During World War II, he played a crucial role in breaking the German Enigma cipher, which accelerated the development of computer science. Charles Babbage is often called the 'Father of the Computer', but the title 'Father of Modern Computers' is specifically credited to Turing for his theoretical contributions.

Extra Facts:
In computer science, the Turing Test is a criterion proposed by Alan Turing to measure a machine's intelligence. The Turing Award is regarded as the highest honor in the field of computer science. Charles Babbage designed the Analytical Engine, a mechanical precursor to the modern computer. James Gosling is known for developing the Java programming language, while Gordon Moore formulated Moore's Law, which predicts the growth of semiconductor complexity.

question:
The most critical part of the UPS is :

[(LMRC Maintainer Electronic Exam 2016)]
options: Battery
Rectifier
Electronic switch
All of the above
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Battery

Explanation:
The Battery is the most critical part of a UPS (Uninterruptible Power Supply) because it is the component that provides backup power when the main power supply is interrupted. The primary purpose of a UPS is to ensure uninterrupted power supply, which is impossible without the battery. When main power fails, the UPS's inverter system converts the DC power stored in the battery into AC power to keep connected devices running. Although the Rectifier and Electronic Switch are also important UPS components, the battery provides the fundamental power backup capability.

Extra Facts:
UPS systems come in three main types: Standby UPS, Line Interactive UPS, and Online UPS. The battery is typically of Sealed Lead-Acid type, known as VRLA (Valve Regulated Lead Acid) battery. The backup time capacity of a UPS depends on the battery's capacity (Ah) and the load. Modern UPS systems also include advanced features like microprocessor control and Automatic Voltage Regulation (AVR).

question:
Which of the following is not a peripheral device (Peripheral device)?

[RRB NTPC, (Shift -3) Online, 03.04.2016, RRB NTPC, (Shift -2) Online, 04.04.2016, RRB NTPC, (Shift -1) Online, 18.03.2016]
options: Printer
Monitor
Motherboard
Keyboard
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Motherboard

Explanation:
Peripheral devices are external devices that connect to a computer system and exchange data with the CPU. Printer, monitor, and keyboard are all peripheral devices because they connect externally to the main system unit. Motherboard is not a peripheral device but rather the main circuit board of a computer where CPU, RAM and other essential components are directly mounted. It serves as the central hub of the computer system that interconnects all components and enables communication between them.

Extra Facts:
Peripheral devices are categorized into three types: input devices (keyboard, mouse), output devices (printer, monitor), and input-output devices (touch screen). The motherboard is often called the 'backbone' of the computer because it connects all hardware components together. It contains the BIOS (Basic Input/Output System) chip that controls the computer's startup process. USB ports, HDMI ports and PCI slots are integrated into the motherboard to facilitate connection of peripheral devices.

question:
........... performs simple addition, subtraction, multiplication, division, and logic operations, such as OR and AND?

[UPPCL TG-2 17/11/2023]
options: Control Unit
Instruction Register
Program Counter
ALU
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is ALU

Explanation:
The ALU (Arithmetic Logic Unit) is a fundamental component of the computer's CPU (Central Processing Unit) that performs all arithmetic and logical operations. It executes arithmetic calculations like addition, subtraction, multiplication, division and logical operations such as AND, OR, NOT. The ALU receives instructions directly from the Control Unit and operates on data stored in registers. It is the core of computer's processing capability and responsible for all computational tasks. While Instruction Register and Program Counter handle control functions, the ALU performs actual calculation operations.

Extra Facts:
The CPU has three main components: ALU (Arithmetic Logic Unit), Control Unit, and Registers. ALU operates on binary number system and uses flip-flop circuits. Microprocessors can have multiple ALUs enabling parallel processing. The speed and capacity of ALU determine the computer's overall performance. It processes data received from input devices and sends it to output devices.

ALU (Arithmetic Logic Unit) कंप्यूटर के CPU (Central Processing Unit) का एक मुख्य घटक है जो सभी अंकगणितीय और तार्किक संक्रियाएँ करता है। यह जोड़, घटाव, गुणा, भाग जैसी अंकगणितीय गणनाएँ और AND, OR, NOT जैसी तार्किक संक्रियाएँ निष्पादित करता है। ALU सीधे कंट्रोल यूनिट से निर्देश प्राप्त करता है और रजिस्टरों में संग्रहीत डेटा पर कार्य करता है। यह कंप्यूटर की प्रोसेसिंग क्षमता का केंद्र बिंदु है और सभी गणनाओं के लिए जिम्मेदार है। इंस्ट्रक्शन रजिस्टर और प्रोग्राम काउंटर नियंत्रण संबंधी कार्य करते हैं, जबकि ALU वास्तविक गणना संचालन करता है।

Extra Facts:
CPU के तीन मुख्य घटक होते हैं: ALU (Arithmetic Logic Unit), कंट्रोल यूनिट और रजिस्टर। ALU बाइनरी नंबर सिस्टम पर कार्य करता है और फ्लिप-फ्लॉप सर्किट का उपयोग करता है। माइक्रोप्रोसेसर में एक से अधिक ALU हो सकते हैं जो पैरेलल प्रोसेसिंग को सक्षम करते हैं। ALU की गति और क्षमता कंप्यूटर के समग्र प्रदर्शन को निर्धारित करती है। यह इनपुट डिवाइस से प्राप्त डेटा को प्रोसेस कर आउटपुट डिवाइस को भेजता है।
